name: Crayola 40 in. x 40 in. x 8 in. Composite Square Sandbox Kit
description: Frame It All - Simple Modular Sandboxes. The sandbox that grows with you. The Frame It All Crayola 40 in. x 40 in. x 8 in. Composite Square Sandbox Kit provides the building blocks of childhood imagination and discovery. Children are immediately attracted to the familiar Crayola logo and bright colors. Snap together connections require no tools for assembly. Timbers will never rot, warp, splinter or fade. Sandbox liner included to prevent weeds while allowing rain or water to drain.
